name: Scenario Shop
description: Dev-only simulated shop for the behavior-comparator harness: search_products/buy_product tools backed by a per-run JSON catalog and purchase-log file. Never makes real network calls or real purchases.

catalogPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON file containing the active scenario's product catalog (array of products). Written per run by the comparator harness.

stateFile.description: Absolute path to a JSON file this plugin appends simulated purchase records to. Written/read per run by the comparator harness; does not need to exist beforehand.
